en: The first image shows the back of a vintage postcard, handwritten in Swedish, addressed to 'Miss May Curley.' The publisher imprint reads 'Förlag Kubikenborgs Proviantförening' and 'Svenska Litografiska AB Stockholm.' The second image is the front of the postcard, showing a colorized photo of a yellow wooden building with arched windows and a front garden. The building is labeled 'Kubikenborgs Skola,' indicating it is a school, surrounded by trees and a flagpole in the foreground.
